# Model-picker brand assets

These assets are bundled locally; the model picker does not load provider icons from a CDN.

| Asset | Source | License / usage note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `openai.svg` | Public OpenAI logomark served by [openai.com](https://openai.com/) | OpenAI trademark; used solely to identify the OpenAI provider. |
| `microsoft.svg` | [Microsoft trademark guidance](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/intellectualproperty/trademarks/usage/general.aspx) four-color window mark | Microsoft trademark; used solely to identify the Microsoft/Phi provider. |
| `deepseek.svg` | [Simple Icons: DeepSeek](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/icons/deepseek.svg) | CC0-1.0. This library-derived asset is not represented as an official DeepSeek asset. |
| `auto-routing.svg` | Project-created neutral routing icon | No provider branding. |
